rationale: No. Read in full (and the inventory corrected): EO 7814 revokes EO 4430 as modified only 'as to' one described 0.50-acre lot; the wording is self-executing, so the one-time command was performed on signing 1938-02-15. EO 8861 (signed 1941-08-20) later revoked EO 4430 as a whole, so no parent withdrawal remains for EO 7814 to modify. EO 8861 does not name EO 7814; the 1989 OFR row 'Revoked by EO 8861' is an editorial reading that was reviewed and not relied on as an ending. The released status of the lot is a surviving consequence, not a continuing command (savings).
